contract.goal: named Kafka clusters for consumers, dead letters and outbox routes, with cluster-scoped dedup and metrics, one replaceable producer seam, and the publisher's X-Correlation-Id on outbox records
contract.output: messaging, outbox, idempotency, observability and architecture-rules changes per design D1-D8; READMEs en/ru; CHANGELOG en/ru
constraints: breaking changes allowed (new major release, user decision) - no shims, no API-baseline exceptions; every breaking change listed under BREAKING in the CHANGELOG
a service declaring no cluster behaves as before at runtime
do not touch the unrelated security-spring-boot-starter import
done_when: mvn -pl :<every in-repo dependent of the five, per scripts/manifest.sh module> -am verify

decisions: User instruction at apply: breaking changes are allowed (major release), and X-Correlation-Id on outbox records is in scope. Proposal, spec, design (D8) and tasks (group 5) updated before the first code edit.

ConsumerActivityMonitor is no longer a RecordInterceptor bean: forCluster(cluster) returns a per-cluster interceptor the builder composes in, because a record does not carry its cluster. Side effect, intended: observability's correlation interceptor becomes the only RecordInterceptor bean, which is what Boot's own container factory needs to pick it up.

KafkaClusters and KafkaClusterProducers live in a separate KafkaClustersAutoConfiguration, not gated by ludwig.messaging.enabled, so the outbox keeps its clusters when messaging's consumer wiring is off.

The outbox reads messaging's correlation header name with Binder in its autoconfiguration, not via MessagingProperties: MessagingProperties' types reach into spring-kafka, which a REST-only outbox does not carry.
Observability publishes CorrelationProvider (before AuditCoreAutoConfiguration). This also gives audit events their correlation id, which they never had.

messaging-db-spring-boot-starter adapted to the new signatures only (cluster argument to metrics and the recoverer; DeadLetterTemplates via the producer seam; per-cluster activity interceptor composed in) so the reactor builds. Its rework onto named clusters remains add-db-log-transport task group 10.
Test names differ from the planned ones (ClaimContractTest/ConsumerDedupIT, MultiClusterOutboxTest under surefire since outbox has no failsafe); tasks.md updated to the real proofs.

User instruction (2026-10-21): fix the unused java.util.ArrayList import in security-spring-boot-starter AuthorizationDeniedAuditListener. Removed (one line); security-spring-boot-starter checkstyle-validate passes.

User instruction (2026-10-21): remove 'return Collections.emptyList();' and the Collections import from security-spring-boot-starter AuthorizationDeniedAuditListener. Done; the file is now identical to its state before commit 3065ec4 (git diff 3065ec4~1 empty) and compiles.
failures: Mutation check (disable cluster binding, expect MultiClusterConsumerIT's dedup case to fail) was refused by the permission system; the test's sensitivity to that bug is reasoned, not measured.
architecture-rules fixture first used the real DefaultKafkaProducerFactory, which is not on that module's classpath; replaced by a test stub of the type, as the module's other Kafka fixtures do.
